# The Handbook

An opening paragraph that should receive a drop cap when typeset, long enough to show the measure doing its work across several lines of serif body text.

See the [setup guide](./guide/01-basics.md) and the [API reference](reference/api.md).

## What it does

Drop a folder of markdown and it becomes one reading edition.

> [!NOTE]
> Callouts use the GitHub blockquote-alert syntax.

### Ordering

Files are ordered by frontmatter, then numeric prefix, then name.
